dedupe_keys.name: neccpb 1 cropland parcel boundaries from meter level imagery of northeast china

description: NECCPB-1 gives 32,395,946 cropland parcel boundaries for Northeast China, a black soil region that the record says supplies about a fifth of China's grain. The Zenodo record says deep learning and an automatic parcel merging strategy were applied to 10.22 TB of very high resolution imagery over 1,240,000 km2, non-cropland was removed using phenology, and validation gave extraction precision 0.85, intersection over union 0.90 and an F1 of 0.92 against public land cover samples, with a -3.6 percent average difference from the Third National Land Survey. It was published in July 2024 by researchers at the Northeast Institute of Geography and Agroecology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as shapefiles by province with a user guide, about 1.25 GB. Coverage is Northeast China. Caveats: the imaging year is not stated in the part read, and parcels carry no crop type. For simulation it gives field-level agricultural assets for flood, drought and hail exposure and loss estimates. Related catalogue records include the Trazo field boundaries for South America and the GloCAB field boundaries.
